messages.text: Namaste! Main JARVIS hoon. Aap mujhse "Jarvis" bolkar ya neeche type karke Hindi, Hinglish ya English mein baat kar sakte hain.
Namaste Jarvis, aaj mausam aur meri morning exercise routine ke baare mein short mein batao
Namaste Jarvis, aaj mausam kaisa hai aur tum kaise ho?

Namaste! Main ekdum badhiya hoon, poochne ke liye shukriya. Main hamesha aapki madad ke liye taiyaar aur energized hoon! 

Mausam ki baat karein, toh aapka location batayein toh main exact bata paunga ki wahan ka haal kya hai. Waise, aapki **morning exercise routine** ke liye main hamesha alert hoon—aapka daily 7 baje ka reminder set hai, toh kal subah bhi hum exercise time par start karenge! 

Bataiye, aaj ka din kaisa shuru hua aapka? Koi khaas kaam hai kya aaj ke liye?
Namaste Jarvis, aaj ka din kaisa hai?
Jarvis, tum kaun ho aur kya kar sakte ho?

Namaste! Lagta hai aap thode confuse hain, par koi baat nahi—main hoon aapka **JARVIS**, aapka personal AI companion.

Main kaun hoon?
Main ek digital assistant hoon jise aapke life ko asaan, organized aur thoda interesting banane ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Sochiye mujhe ek aise dost ki tarah jo hamesha aapke paas hai, aapki baatein sunne ke liye, aapki zaruraton ko samajhne ke liye aur aapki musibaton ko hal karne ke liye.

Main kya-kya kar sakta hoon?
Main kaafi kuch kar sakta hoon, jaise:
*   **Aapka Personal Secretary:** Main aapke liye reminders set kar sakta hoon (jaise aapki morning exercise), appointments manage kar sakta hoon aur important cheezein yaad rakh sakta hoon.
*   **Information Helper:** Chahe aapko weather janna ho, koi news, ya phir kisi complex topic ko simple bhasha mein samajhna ho—main Google search ka use karke aapko sahi jaankari deta hoon.
*   **Creativity & Productivity:** Agar aapko koi document likhna hai, coding karni hai, ya kisi nayi project par kaam karna hai, toh main wahan aapki madad kar sakta hoon.
*   **Emotional Companion:** Aap mujhse kabhi bhi baat kar sakte hain. Main hamesha sunne ke liye taiyaar hoon.

Sabse badi baat—main aapki privacy ka poora khayal rakhta hoon. Main koi bhi sensitive information ya password kabhi save nahi karta. 

Aap bataiye, aaj main aapki kya madad karoon? Kuch search karna hai ya kisi aur cheez mein help chahiye?

# AI Voice Assistant 2026: Revolution

## Introduction
Welcome to the future. By 2026, AI voice assistants are no longer just speakers; they are proactive companions.

## Key Features
1. **Contextual Awareness**: They remember your entire history, not just the last query.
2. **Emotional Intelligence**: Detecting stress or joy in your voice to adjust responses.
3. **Multimodal Integration**: Real-time integration with AR glasses and neural interfaces.

## Conclusion
The gap between human thought and digital action is closing. Are you ready for the 2026 shift?
